explanation: The theorem is a very specific result. A chart of open immersions gives a morphism of schemes whose fibre over a field point is an open immersion near x. It concludes that there is an open neighbourhood W of the point on which the composite w ≫ π is formally unramified. I searched Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry for FormallyUnramified. The only files are Morphisms/FormallyUnramified.lean, Morphisms/Etale.lean and Morphisms/LocalFlatDescent.lean. None of them has a statement like this. The proof relies on the library's own local lemma exists_formallyUnramified_away_of_baseChange, which is not in Mathlib.
